patch.value: Public reproduction evidence and first release certification
Three real public failures from at least sixteen atoms; exact provenance, resumes and packed consumers; full source coverage and npm plus Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Public proof is complete for three reproduced historical defects across two public packages: Beads numeric preservation, Jev Unicode tokenization, and Jev UTF-8 exemplar packing. Each reduces 16 atoms to 1 with independent failing-final and passing-deletion observations, retained caller-owned immutable result snapshots, frozen native source revisions, and public source hashes. Reservations/actual executions are 8/10, 8/10 and 6/8. Five pending-result handoffs and ten independent resume questions pass for each. Packets include frozen oracle identities and latest operation receipts; full JSON evidence retains the complete independently checked reduction snapshots. No synthetic defect is counted as real data.
